about.label: ABOUT PREMIER
about.headline: Where Digital Precision Meets Dental Craftsmanship
about.p1: At Premier Dental Lab, we bring together digital dentistry, modern CAD/CAM technology, and meticulous craftsmanship to support dental professionals in delivering exceptional restorative solutions.
about.p2: Based in Erbil, Iraq, our laboratory is dedicated to combining advanced digital workflows with careful attention to detail throughout the restoration process.
about.p3: We believe that every restoration deserves precision, consistency, and a commitment to quality.
about.philosophy: Precision in design. Excellence in craftsmanship. Confidence in every restoration.
about.craftsmanshipSub: Meticulous human finishing paired with digital accuracy
about.imageAlt: Premier Dental Lab technician designing custom dental restorations at CAD/CAM workstation in Erbil, Iraq

services.label: OUR SERVICES
services.headline: Digital Solutions for Modern Dentistry
services.description: Explore our approach to digital dental restorations, where modern technology and careful craftsmanship come together to support clinical workflows.
services.catalogFrameworkDesc: From individual restorations to complex restorative cases, Premier Dental Lab supports dental professionals with customized solutions designed around each clinical requirement.
services.restorativeImageAlt: Illustrative presentation of dental crowns, bridges, veneers, and implant-supported restorations
services.pillar1Desc: Patient-specific dental restorations shaped with precise margin adaptation, anatomical contours, and natural aesthetic harmony.
services.pillar2Desc: Seamless ingestion of digital impression data (STL, PLY, OBJ) from intraoral scanner systems, accelerating clinic-to-lab turnaround.
services.pillar3Desc: Direct technical dialogue between our technicians and practicing dentists for case planning, restorative strategy, and shade verification.
